snippet.title: GHOST TOWN Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Fireproof Games are pleased to announce GHOST TOWN is out now on Steam as well as Meta Quest and coming to PSVR2  later in 2025.

https://bit.ly/GhostTown_SteamVR

Check out our website for more info & FAQ:
https://www.fireproofgames.com/games/... 
──────────────────────────────────────────────────── 
Welcome to the supernatural world of Ghost Town, a single-player puzzle adventure VR game by Fireproof Games, creators of the widely acclaimed game series ‘The Room’.

HANDS-ON EXPLORATION
Use the unique physicality of VR to explore a variety of atmospheric locations with a controller in each hand and a torch to light your way. Experience encounters with a diverse range of characters, both living and dead to learn the compelling secrets behind hauntings. Use the dexterity of your hands to overcome tactile puzzles, cast spells and even summon troubled spirits to move them on to the next world.

UNRAVEL A MYSTERIOUS DISAPPEARANCE 
Life has been going well for Edith. The paranormal detective agency she runs with her flatmate has never been busier, she’s almost up-to-date with her rent and the ghosts in her bathroom mirror have been less demanding than usual. But Edith’s world is turned upside down when her brother goes missing and a mysterious new lead promises to reveal clues of his whereabouts. Edith’s journey begins with a visit to a remote Scottish island in the hope a gifted clairvoyant can provide some much-needed answers.
──────────────────────────────────────────────────── 
ENHANCED FOR PC
• Realtime environmental shadows
• Realtime torch shadows
• Higher render resolution 
• Higher texture resolution
• Higher material complexity
• Higher geometry detail distances
• Higher number of realtime lights
• Higher VFX fidelity 
• Interactive smoke VFX
• Bloom
──────────────────────────────────────────────────── 
THE POWER OF VR Atmospheric puzzle gameplay with an authentic sense of realism
BELIEVABLE LOCATIONS A wide variety of locations to fully to discover and explore
A RICH STORY An engaging narrative with a diverse range of characters to interact with
VR COMFORT A selection of settings to ensure your VR experience is as enjoyable as possible
3D AUDIO Haunting music and dynamic spatial 3D sound effects for a compelling sense of immersion
MULTI LANGUAGE SUPPORT Available in English, French, Italian, German & Spanish
──────────────────────────────────────────────────── 
Fireproof Games is an independent studio from Guildford, United Kingdom.
fireproofgames.com
